text.tspan: Global reported natural disasters by type 1970 to 2025
The annual reported number of natural disasters, categorized by type. Note that this largely reflects increases in
data reporting, and should not be used to assess the total number of events.

tspan.tspan: Data includes disasters reported up to April 2026.
